description.en: Region, BIOS, memory cards and CPU clock settings.
description.zh-Hans: 地区、BIOS、记忆卡与 CPU 频率。

description.en: Specify which region the system is from. 'NTSC' is 60 Hz while 'PAL' is 50 Hz. 'Auto' will detect the region of the currently loaded content. Games may run faster or slower than normal if the incorrect region is selected.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟主机的地区。NTSC 为 60Hz，PAL 为 50Hz。「自动」按游戏识别，选错会导致游戏速度异常。

description.en: Specify which BIOS to use. 'Auto' will attempt to load a real bios file from the frontend 'system' directory, falling back to high level emulation if unavailable. 'HLE' forces high level BIOS emulation. It is recommended to use an official bios file for better compatibility.
description.zh-Hans: 使用哪个 BIOS。「自动」优先使用核心 BIOS 中添加的真机 BIOS 文件，没有时退回高层模拟；「HLE」强制使用高层模拟，兼容性较差。

description.en: When using an official BIOS file, specify whether to show the PlayStation logo upon starting or resetting content. Warning: Enabling the boot logo may reduce game compatibility.
description.zh-Hans: 使用真机 BIOS 时，启动或重置游戏是否显示 PlayStation 开机动画。注意：开启后部分游戏兼容性会下降。

title.zh-Hans: 显示 BIOS 开机动画

description.en: Emulate a second memory card in slot 2. This will be shared by all games.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟插在 2 号卡槽的记忆卡，所有游戏共用同一份。

description.en: Reads the specified amount of sectors ahead of time to try to avoid later stalls. 333000 will try to read the complete disk (requires an additional 750MB of RAM).
description.zh-Hans: 提前读取指定数量的扇区，减少读盘卡顿。设为 333000 会尝试读入整张光盘，额外占用约 750MB 内存。

description.en: Overclock or under-clock the PSX CPU. Should be much less than 100 (something like 57) due to some real hardware slowdowns not being emulated. Usually should be left at 'Auto', else glitches or hangs are likely.
description.zh-Hans: 对模拟 CPU 超频或降频。由于部分真机的减速行为没有被模拟，这个值通常要明显低于 100（例如 57）。建议保持「自动」，否则容易出现画面异常。

description.en: Dithering, frameskip, centering and overscan settings.
description.zh-Hans: 抖动、跳帧、画面居中与过扫描。

description.en: Enable emulation of the dithering technique used by the PSX to smooth out color banding artifacts. "Force" enables it even if the game turns it off. Increases performance requirements.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟 PS 用来掩盖色阶断层的抖动处理。「强制」即使游戏关闭了抖动也照样应用，会增加性能开销。

description.en: Skip frames to avoid audio buffer under-run (crackling). Improves performance at the expense of visual smoothness. 'Auto' skips frames when advised by the frontend. 'Auto (Threshold)' utilises the 'Frameskip Threshold (%)' setting. 'Fixed Interval' utilises the 'Frameskip Interval' setting.
description.zh-Hans: 跳过部分画面以避免音频爆音，代价是画面不够流畅。「自动」按前端提示跳帧，「自动（阈值）」使用下面的阈值，「固定间隔」按固定间隔跳帧。

description.en: When 'Frameskip' is set to 'Auto (Threshold)', specifies the audio buffer occupancy threshold (percentage) below which frames will be skipped. Higher values reduce the risk of crackling by causing frames to be dropped more frequently.
description.zh-Hans: 跳帧设为「自动（阈值）」时，音频缓冲低于该百分比就开始跳帧。数值越高跳帧越频繁，越不容易爆音。

description.en: Specify the maximum number of frames that can be skipped before a new frame is rendered.
description.zh-Hans: 连续跳过的画面数量上限，超过后必须渲染一帧。

description.en: Show the internal frame rate at which the emulated PlayStation system is rendering content. Note: Requires on-screen notifications to be enabled in the libretro frontend.
description.zh-Hans: 显示模拟主机实际渲染的帧率。

description.en: Instead of the exact 50 or 60 (maximum) fps for PAL/NTSC the real console runs closer to something like 49.75 and 59.81fps (varies slightly between hw versions). PCSX-ReARMed uses the former "round" framerates to better match modern displays, however that may cause audio/video desync in games like DDR and Spyro 2 (intro). With this option you can try to use fractional framerates.
description.zh-Hans: 真机的帧率其实是 49.75 / 59.81 这样的小数，而不是整数的 50 / 60。开启后使用更精确的帧率，画面滚动可能更平滑，也可能与设备刷新率不匹配。

description.en: Improves color depth for true color modes (most FMVs and occasional title screens). Causes higher CPU usage due to double memory bandwidth requirement, even in 15bpp modes. Takes effect on game reload only (libretro limitation).
description.zh-Hans: 提升真彩色画面（多数过场动画和部分标题画面）的色彩精度。内存带宽翻倍，CPU 占用更高。

description.en: Slower but more accurate GPU linked list processing. Needed by only a few games like Vampire Hunter D. Should be autodetected in most cases.
description.zh-Hans: 更慢但更精确的 GPU 链表处理。只有《吸血鬼猎人 D》等少数游戏需要，通常会自动识别。

description.en: The PSX can display graphics way into the horizontal borders, even if most screens would crop it. This option tries to display all such graphics. Note that this may result in unusual resolutions that your device might not handle well. The 'Hack' option is intended for the widescreen hacks.
description.zh-Hans: PS 可以在画面左右边界之外绘制内容，多数电视会裁掉。开启后尽量显示这部分内容，可能出现不常见的分辨率。

description.en: The PSX has a feature allowing it to shift the image position on screen. Some (mostly PAL) games used this feature in a strange way making the image miscentered and causing uneven borders to appear. With 'Auto' the emulator tries to correct this miscentering automatically. 'Game-controlled' uses the settings supplied by the game. 'Manual' allows to override those values with the settings below.
description.zh-Hans: PS 允许游戏移动画面位置。部分游戏（多为 PAL 版）用得比较奇怪，导致画面偏移、黑边不均。

description.en: X offset of the frame buffer. Only effective when 'Screen centering' is set to 'Manual'.
description.zh-Hans: 画面的水平偏移量，仅在画面居中设为「手动」时有效。

description.en: Y offset of the frame buffer. Only effective when 'Screen centering' is set to 'Manual'.
description.zh-Hans: 画面的垂直偏移量，仅在画面居中设为「手动」时有效。

description.en: Height adjustment. Only effective when 'Screen centering' is set to 'Manual'.
description.zh-Hans: 画面高度的调整量，仅在画面居中设为「手动」时有效。

description.en: Low-level settings of the NEON GPU plugin.
description.zh-Hans: NEON GPU 插件的底层设置。

description.en: When enabled, games that run in high resolution video modes (480i, 512i) will produced interlaced video output. While this displays correctly on CRT televisions, it will produce artifacts on modern displays. When disabled, all video is output in progressive format. Note: there are games that will glitch is this is off.
description.zh-Hans: 高分辨率模式（480i、512i）的游戏是否输出隔行画面。隔行在 CRT 电视上正常，在现代屏幕上会出现横纹。

description.en: Render games that do not already run in high resolution video modes (480i, 512i) at twice the native internal resolution. Improves the fidelity of 3D models at the expense of increased performance requirements. 2D elements are generally unaffected by this setting.
description.zh-Hans: 把本来不是高分辨率的游戏以两倍原生分辨率渲染，3D 模型更精细，性能开销更大。

description.en: ('Enhanced Resolution' Hack) Improves performance but reduces compatibility and may cause rendering errors.
description.zh-Hans: 提升分辨率时的加速手段，性能更好但兼容性下降，可能出现渲染错误。

description.en: ('Enhanced Resolution' Hack) Solves some texturing issues in some games in Enhanced Resolution mode. May cause a small performance hit.
description.zh-Hans: 修正提升分辨率后部分游戏的纹理问题，会带来少量性能开销。

description.en: Reverb, interpolation and CD/XA audio settings.
description.zh-Hans: 混响、插值与 CD/XA 音轨。

description.en: Enable emulation of the reverb feature provided by the PSX SPU. Can be disabled to improve performance at the expense of reduced audio quality/authenticity.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟 PS 声音处理器的混响效果。关闭可提升性能，但音效会失真于原版。

description.en: Enable emulation of the in-built audio interpolation provided by the PSX SPU. 'Gaussian' sounds closest to original hardware. 'Simple' improves performance but reduces quality. 'Cubic' has the highest performance requirements but produces increased clarity. Can be disabled entirely for maximum performance, at the expense of greatly reduced audio quality.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟 PS 声音处理器内置的插值处理。「高斯」最接近真机；「简单」性能更好但音质下降；「三次」高频最清晰。

description.en: Enable playback of CD (CD-DA) audio tracks. Can be disabled to improve performance in games that include CD audio, at the expense of missing music.
description.zh-Hans: 播放光盘上的 CD-DA 音轨。关闭可在含 CD 音乐的游戏中提升性能，代价是没有背景音乐。

description.en: Enable playback of XA (eXtended Architecture ADPCM) audio tracks. Can be disabled to improve performance in games that include XA audio, at the expense of missing music.
description.zh-Hans: 播放 XA 格式的音轨。关闭可在含 XA 音乐的游戏中提升性能，代价是没有背景音乐。

description.en: Emulates the PSX SPU on another CPU thread. May cause audio glitches in some games.
description.zh-Hans: 在独立线程上模拟 PS 的声音处理器。部分游戏可能出现杂音。

description.en: Analog sticks, rumble, multitap and neGcon settings.
description.zh-Hans: 摇杆、震动、多人适配器与 neGcon。

description.en: Specify range limits for the left and right analog sticks when input device is set to 'analog' or 'dualshock'. 'Square' bounds improve input response when using controllers with highly circular ranges that are unable to fully saturate the X and Y axes at 45 degree deflections.
description.zh-Hans: 使用模拟手柄或双摇杆手柄时摇杆的取值范围。「方形」能改善圆形限位手柄的输入响应。

description.en: Enable haptic feedback when using a rumble-equipped gamepad with input device set to 'dualshock'.
description.zh-Hans: 手柄设为双摇杆手柄且支持震动时启用震动反馈。

description.en: When the input device type is DualShock, this option allows the emulated DualShock to be toggled between DIGITAL and ANALOG mode like original hardware. You can select the button combination for this.
description.zh-Hans: 用于在数字模式和模拟模式之间切换的组合键，与真机的 ANALOG 键作用相同。

description.en: Connect a virtual PSX Multitap peripheral to either controller 'Port 1' or controller 'Port 2' for 5 player simultaneous input, or to both 'Ports 1 and 2' for 8 player input. Mutlitap usage requires compatible games.
description.zh-Hans: 在 1 号或 2 号手柄口连接多人适配器可支持 5 人同时游玩，两个口都接则支持 8 人。部分游戏不支持适配器。

description.en: Set the deadzone of the RetroPad left analog stick when simulating the 'twist' action of emulated neGcon Controllers. Used to eliminate drift/unwanted input.
description.zh-Hans: 用左摇杆模拟 neGcon 手柄扭转动作时的死区，可消除摇杆漂移。

description.en: Specify the analog response when using a RetroPad left analog stick to simulate the 'twist' action of emulated neGcon Controllers.
description.zh-Hans: 用左摇杆模拟 neGcon 扭转动作时的响应曲线。

description.en: Adjust responsiveness of emulated 'mouse' input devices.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟鼠标设备的灵敏度。

description.en: Settings required for specific games to run correctly.
description.zh-Hans: 特定游戏正常运行所需的设置。

description.en: Enable emulation of the PSX CPU instruction cache. Improves accuracy at the expense of increased performance overheads. Required for Formula One 2001, Formula One Arcade and Formula One 99. [Interpreter only; partial on lightrec and ARM dynarecs]
description.zh-Hans: 模拟 PS 处理器的指令缓存，更准确但更耗性能。《一级方程式 99 / 2001》等游戏需要开启。

description.en: Enable emulation of some almost never used PSX's debug features. This causes a performance hit, is not useful for games and is intended for PSX homebrew and romhack developers only. Only enable if you know what you are doing. [Interpreter only]
description.zh-Hans: 模拟 PS 上几乎用不到的调试功能。会降低性能，对游戏没有帮助，仅供自制程序和改版开发者使用。

description.en: Hacks that trade accuracy and stability for performance.
description.zh-Hans: 以准确性和稳定性换取性能的手段。

description.en: This makes the emulated CD-ROM extremely fast and can reduce loading times in some cases. Warning: many games were not programmed to handle such a speed. The game (or even the emulator) MAY CRASH at ANY TIME if this is enabled.
description.zh-Hans: 让模拟光驱以极高速度读取，大幅缩短读盘时间。注意：很多游戏没有考虑这种速度，可能导致游戏甚至模拟器出错。

description.en: Will cause some games to run too quickly. Should be disabled in almost all cases.
description.zh-Hans: 会让部分游戏运行过快，绝大多数情况下都应保持关闭。
